newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Mobil Nigeria installs gas compression dec.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Nigeria installs gas compression dec.

text.p: Mobil Producing Nigeria Unlimited, the operator of a joint venture between Mobil Corp and state-owned Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC), said it had installed new and modern equipment to gather flared gas.
The 4,700 ton gas compression platform was installed at Mobil's Ekpe oil field located offshore, 37 miles southwest of its Qua Iboe terminal in the Bight of Benin.

"The compression platform will be used to collect previously flared gas for use in recovery projects which will add an additional 100 million barrels of reserves to the field," Mobil said in a statement.
"This project is part of the NNPC/Mobil joint venture's strategy to eliminate gas flaring by 1999," the statement added.
Mobil, which is the lowest cost producer of crude oil in Nigeria, said the installation of the platform marked another success in its cost-reduction efforts.
It said it used the "float-over" technique, the first by an oil firm in Nigeria, to install the platform in 165 feet of water, reducing the cost by 10 percent "over previous lift installed systems."
The Ekpe field in NNPC/Mobil venture's OML 70 currently produces 45,000 bpd and 80 million cubic feet of natural gas daily.
